sources.title: YunzeLiu/fastwam-trex62-side-branch-icl · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the side-branch FastWAM-ICL checkpoint trained on the pick_fruits subset of wushr-lance/VLA2Vec. Both ICL variants start from the exact same FastWAM T-Rex baseline at step 27,708 and use the same manually audited, fixed EgoDex reference.

sources.title: Yunze Liu - Tsinghua University
sources.snippet: About Me I am a final-year Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS), Tsinghua University, advised by Prof. Li Yi. I am currently a Research Intern at NVIDIA Research, where I work on in-context learning for Physical AI, mentored by Dr. Han Cai, with guidance from Prof. Song Han.
